en.code.robots_denied: The site's robots.txt asks not to read this page, and Rastro respects it.
en.code.invalid_robots: The site's access rules (robots.txt) could not be read, so Rastro did not read the site.
en.code.access_restricted: The site answered that access is restricted. Rastro does not try to get around it.
en.code.challenge_unsolved: The site showed a challenge (for example a captcha). Rastro does not solve it.
en.code.rate_limited: The site asked to slow down. Try again later.

en.code.http_permanent_failure: The page was not found. Check the address.
en.code.network_failure: The connection failed. Try again later.
en.code.request_timeout: The site took too long to answer.
en.code.missing_fields: Records were missing fields; the page may have changed.
en.code.validation_error: A value did not match the expected type.
en.code.spider_page_limit: The link-following page cap was reached.
en.code.scroll_max_steps: The scroll step cap was reached.
en.code.request_limit: The run's request budget was spent.
